findings.identityMatch: Official JP detail page card 1082: カビゴン LV.35, image path card_images/large/DP1/001082_P_KABIGON.jpg, regulation mark DP1, attacks とおせんぼ/ねころがる, illus Ken Sugimori; listed products include 拡張パック「時空の創造 ダイヤモンドコレクション/パールコレクション」.
findings.notes: DP-era Japanese cards carry a DP Battle Pokédex identifier, not a set collector number with denominator. The official card image (raw/pcc_img_DP1_001082_P_KABIGON.jpg) shows "DPBP#174" printed bottom right. There is NO denominator; record as source-native identifier and let the data owner decide whether collectorNumber may hold a DPBP value. Corroborated by 52poke 卡比兽（DP1） (raw/52poke_卡比兽（DP1）.html: "钻石收集 DP系列 2006-11-03 ◆ DPBP#174"). PokeCottage catalogue number "94" is its own index, not printed. Applies equally to 1st Edition and Unlimited placeholders only as the printed identifier of the card; edition not established here.
